import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares

__all__ = ['calibrate_affine_gauges', 'align_reference_features', 'fit_predict_preloaded']


def calibrate_affine_gauges(
    command: np.ndarray, measured: np.ndarray, check_group: np.ndarray,
    groups: np.ndarray, *, stress_scale: float, prior: np.ndarray | None = None,
    pair_span: float = 0.05, consensus_span: float = 0.10,
    residual_tol: float = 0.001, spot_tol: float = 0.02,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return physical [gain, bias] maps and a strict local-consensus mask.

    Commands, measurements and prior biases share stress units. All tolerances
    are relative to stress_scale. The prior is supplied in requested group
    order, e.g. from the latest trustworthy historical panel. Require a positive
    gain and at least three checks in a strict majority over consensus_span.
    Otherwise retain the prior gain and adjust only its bias using compatible
    spots. Exactly two well-separated checks may give a provisional positive
    map when both disagree with a supplied prior (or when no prior exists);
    they cannot distinguish drift from EMI and never set the consensus mask.
    Without a supplied prior the fallback map is nominal identity.
    """
    if not (0 < stress_scale < np.inf and 0 < pair_span <= consensus_span < np.inf
            and 0 < residual_tol <= spot_tol < np.inf):
        raise ValueError('expected positive finite calibration scales and tolerances')
    x = np.asarray(command, dtype=float) / stress_scale
    y = np.asarray(measured, dtype=float) / stress_scale
    labels, groups = np.asarray(check_group), np.asarray(groups)
    if x.ndim != 1 or y.shape != x.shape or labels.shape != x.shape or groups.ndim != 1:
        raise ValueError('expected matching check vectors and a requested group vector')
    maps = (np.tile([1., 0.], (len(groups), 1)) if prior is None
            else np.array(prior, dtype=float, copy=True))
    if maps.shape != (len(groups), 2) or not np.isfinite(maps).all() or np.any(maps[:, 0] <= 0):
        raise ValueError('expected a finite positive-gain prior for each group')
    maps[:, 1] /= stress_scale
    identified = np.zeros(len(groups), dtype=bool)
    finite = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y)
    for k, label in enumerate(groups):
        use = finite & (labels == label)
        a, b = x[use], y[use]
        n = len(a)
        if n == 0:
            continue
        h = max(3, n // 2 + 1)
        design = np.column_stack((a, np.ones(n)))
        span = np.ptp(a)
        best = None
        if n >= h and span >= consensus_span:
            i, j = np.triu_indices(n, k=1)
            use_pair = np.abs(a[j] - a[i]) >= max(pair_span, 0.05 * span)
            for u, v in zip(i[use_pair], j[use_pair]):
                gain = (b[v] - b[u]) / (a[v] - a[u])
                if gain <= 0:
                    continue
                good = np.abs(b - b[u] - gain * (a - a[u])) <= residual_tol
                if good.sum() < h or np.ptp(a[good]) < consensus_span:
                    continue
                fit = np.linalg.lstsq(design[good], b[good], rcond=None)[0]
                err = b - design @ fit
                good = np.abs(err) <= residual_tol
                count = good.sum()
                if fit[0] <= 0 or count < h or np.ptp(a[good]) < consensus_span:
                    continue
                score = (-count, float(err[good] @ err[good]))
                if best is None or score < best:
                    best, maps[k], identified[k] = score, fit, True
        if identified[k]:
            continue
        offset = b - design @ maps[k]
        if (n == 2 and span >= consensus_span
                and (prior is None or np.all(np.abs(offset) > residual_tol))):
            gain = (b[1] - b[0]) / (a[1] - a[0])
            if gain > 0:
                maps[k] = [gain, b[0] - gain * a[0]]
                continue
        if prior is not None:
            compatible = np.abs(offset) <= spot_tol
            if compatible.any():
                maps[k, 1] += np.median(offset[compatible])
    maps[:, 1] *= stress_scale
    return maps, identified


def align_reference_features(
    raw: np.ndarray, reference: np.ndarray, group: np.ndarray, stratum: np.ndarray,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return aligned, imputed features and the original complete-row mask.

    Each group shares an additive offset and a positive scale between its
    features and reference controls. Reference rows may include prediction
    specimens if those controls are available. Estimate offset and scale as
    medians of reference-column means and population standard deviations using
    columns with at least two finite entries. Impute each aligned feature with
    the mean of its observed cell means, giving each contributing group–stratum
    cell equal weight. There is no scale floor or fallback for unsupported data.
    """
    x = np.array(raw, dtype=float, copy=True)
    refs = np.asarray(reference, dtype=float)
    group, stratum = np.asarray(group), np.asarray(stratum)
    if (x.ndim != 2 or not x.size or refs.ndim != 2 or len(refs) != len(x)
            or group.shape != (len(x),) or stratum.shape != group.shape):
        raise ValueError('expected feature and reference matrices with matching row labels')
    _, g = np.unique(group, return_inverse=True)
    _, s = np.unique(stratum, return_inverse=True)
    observed = np.isfinite(x)
    for label in np.unique(g):
        rows = g == label
        panel = refs[rows]
        finite = np.isfinite(panel)
        keep = finite.sum(axis=0) >= 2
        if not keep.any():
            raise ValueError('group has no supported reference columns')
        panel = np.where(finite[:, keep], panel[:, keep], np.nan)
        center = np.median(np.nanmean(panel, axis=0))
        scale = np.median(np.nanstd(panel, axis=0, ddof=0))
        if not 0 < scale < np.inf:
            raise ValueError('group needs a finite positive reference scale')
        x[rows] = (x[rows] - center) / scale
    cells, index = np.unique(np.column_stack((g, s)), axis=0, return_inverse=True)
    index = index.reshape(-1)
    count = np.zeros((len(cells), x.shape[1]))
    total = np.zeros_like(count)
    np.add.at(count, index, observed)
    np.add.at(total, index, np.where(observed, x, 0.))
    support = np.count_nonzero(count, axis=0)
    if np.any(support == 0):
        raise ValueError('a feature is unobserved in every cell')
    means = np.divide(total, count, out=np.zeros_like(total), where=count > 0)
    return np.where(observed, x, means.sum(axis=0) / support), observed.all(axis=1)


def fit_predict_preloaded(
    history: np.ndarray, hold: np.ndarray, durations: np.ndarray, times: np.ndarray,
    preload: np.ndarray, initial_strain: np.ndarray, features: np.ndarray,
    complete: np.ndarray, training: np.ndarray, strain_observed: np.ndarray,
    rate_observed: np.ndarray, critical_strain: np.ndarray, *, time_scale: float,
    stress_scale: float, strain_scale: float, stress_floor: float,
    tau_bounds: tuple[float, float], seed_scale: float = 0.035,
    mad_multiplier: float = 3.0, noise_floor: float = 1e-5, rank_rtol: float = 1e-8,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return ordered physical taus, strain curves, secants and crossing times.

    History contains calibrated piecewise-constant stresses in chronological
    order with a shared duration per column; hold is constant per row. Preload
    is a calibrated (n, 2) stress-state array before the history, with the fast
    branch first. The hold law has two exponential increments plus linear drift;
    it does not model an additional yield transition. Only originally complete
    training rows fit the shared law. Nonfinite observations are omitted. A
    finite trusted onset rate replaces only the drift of an incomplete
    prediction row, never the memory state. Outputs cover every input row.

    Optimization uses dimensionless stress, time, strain and onset rate, with
    soft-L1 starts (0.035 default) and one Cauchy refinement (3 times channel MAD,
    floored at 1e-5). No coefficient ridge is used; a failed or rank-deficient
    fit raises instead of falling back to imputed training rows. Secants use a
    caller-supplied physical stress floor. The first upward threshold hit is
    interpolated from the onset anchor and sampled points; a row already at or
    above threshold returns zero, and a non-hit returns the final sample time.
    """
    scales = np.array([time_scale, stress_scale, strain_scale, stress_floor,
                       seed_scale, mad_multiplier, noise_floor, rank_rtol])
    if not np.isfinite(scales).all() or np.any(scales <= 0):
        raise ValueError('physical scales, floor, and fit tolerances must be positive')
    h = np.asarray(history, dtype=float) / stress_scale
    p = np.asarray(hold, dtype=float) / stress_scale
    z = np.asarray(preload, dtype=float) / stress_scale
    d = np.asarray(durations, dtype=float) / time_scale
    t = np.asarray(times, dtype=float) / time_scale
    eps0 = np.asarray(initial_strain, dtype=float)
    x = np.asarray(features, dtype=float)
    critical = np.asarray(critical_strain, dtype=float)
    complete, training = np.asarray(complete, dtype=bool), np.asarray(training, dtype=bool)
    obs = np.asarray(strain_observed, dtype=float)
    rate = np.asarray(rate_observed, dtype=float) / (strain_scale / time_scale)
    lo, hi = np.asarray(tau_bounds, dtype=float) / time_scale
    n = p.size
    if (p.ndim != 1 or h.ndim != 2 or h.shape[0] != n or d.shape != (h.shape[1],)
            or z.shape != (n, 2) or x.ndim != 2 or len(x) != n or t.ndim != 1
            or obs.shape != (n, t.size) or any(v.shape != (n,) for v in
            (eps0, critical, complete, training, rate))):
        raise ValueError('inconsistent specimen, history, or observation shapes')
    if (not all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in (h, p, z, d, t, eps0, x, critical))
            or not 0 < lo < hi < np.inf or np.any(d < 0) or not t.size
            or t[0] < 0 or t[-1] <= 0 or np.any(np.diff(t) <= 0)):
        raise ValueError('expected finite inputs, nonnegative durations and ordered times and bounds')
    cov = np.column_stack((np.ones(n), x))
    eps = (obs - eps0[:, None]) / strain_scale
    use = training & complete
    rows, cols = np.nonzero(use[:, None] & np.isfinite(eps))
    rr = np.flatnonzero(use & np.isfinite(rate))
    nc, nr = len(rows), len(rr)
    nw = cov.shape[1] + 2
    if not nc or not nr or nc + nr < nw + 2:
        raise ValueError('insufficient complete training observations')
    y = np.r_[eps[rows, cols], rate[rr]]
    fit_rows, inverse = np.unique(np.r_[rows, rr], return_inverse=True)
    ic, ir = inverse[:nc], inverse[nc:]
    tc = t[cols, None]
    tail = (np.r_[np.cumsum(d[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.] if d.size else d)[:, None]
    elapsed = d.sum()
    lower = np.log(lo)
    span = np.log(hi) - lower

    def ordered(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        a, b = q[:2]
        return np.exp(lower + span * np.array([a, a + (1. - a) * b]))

    def memory(tau: np.ndarray, hh: np.ndarray, pp: np.ndarray, zz: np.ndarray,
               derivative: bool = False) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray | None]:
        early = np.exp(-tail / tau)
        weight = early * -np.expm1(-d[:, None] / tau)
        seed = zz * np.exp(-elapsed / tau)
        jump = pp[:, None] - seed - hh @ weight
        if not derivative:
            return jump, None
        end = np.exp(-(tail + d[:, None]) / tau)
        dj = -(elapsed * seed + hh @ (tail * weight - d[:, None] * end)) / tau**2
        return jump, dj

    def evaluate(q: np.ndarray, derivative: bool = False) -> np.ndarray:
        tau = ordered(q)
        j, dj = memory(tau, h[fit_rows], p[fit_rows], z[fit_rows], derivative)
        phi = -np.expm1(-tc / tau)
        design = np.vstack((np.column_stack((j[ic] * phi, cov[rows] * tc)),
                            np.column_stack((j[ir] / tau, cov[rr]))))
        if not derivative:
            return design
        dphi = -tc * np.exp(-tc / tau) / tau**2
        direct = np.vstack((dj[ic] * phi + j[ic] * dphi,
                            dj[ir] / tau - j[ir] / tau**2)) * q[2:4]
        transform = span * tau[:, None] * np.array([[1., 0.], [1. - q[1], 1. - q[0]]])
        return np.column_stack((direct @ transform, design))

    def residual(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return evaluate(q) @ q[2:] - y

    bounds = (np.r_[0., 1e-5, np.full(nw, -np.inf)],
              np.r_[1. - 1e-5, 1., np.full(nw, np.inf)])
    fits = []
    for start in ((.12, .34), (.25, .65), (.45, .65), (.65, .50)):
        q = np.r_[start, np.zeros(nw)]
        q[2:] = np.linalg.lstsq(evaluate(q), y, rcond=None)[0]
        fits.append(least_squares(residual, q, jac=lambda v: evaluate(v, True),
                                  bounds=bounds, loss='soft_l1', f_scale=seed_scale,
                                  max_nfev=160))
    q = min(fits, key=lambda fit: fit.cost).x
    err = residual(q)
    channel_scale = []
    for block in (err[:nc], err[nc:]):
        mad = 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(block - np.median(block)))
        channel_scale.append(max(noise_floor, mad_multiplier * mad))
    sigma = np.repeat(channel_scale, [nc, nr])
    opt = least_squares(lambda v: residual(v) / sigma, q,
                        jac=lambda v: evaluate(v, True) / sigma[:, None],
                        bounds=bounds, loss='cauchy', max_nfev=400)
    sv = np.linalg.svd(opt.jac, compute_uv=False)
    if not opt.success or sv[-1] <= rank_rtol * sv[0]:
        raise ValueError('shared law did not converge to a locally identifiable fit')
    tau = ordered(opt.x)
    jump, _ = memory(tau, h, p, z)
    amplitude = jump * opt.x[2:4]
    drift = cov @ opt.x[4:]
    informed = ~training & ~complete & np.isfinite(rate)
    drift[informed] = rate[informed] - amplitude[informed] @ (1. / tau)
    increment = strain_scale * (amplitude @ -np.expm1(-t[None, :] / tau[:, None])
                                + drift[:, None] * t)
    curve = eps0[:, None] + increment
    secant = increment[:, -1] / np.maximum(np.abs(p) * stress_scale, stress_floor)
    positive = t > 0
    values = np.column_stack((eps0, curve[:, positive]))
    grid = np.r_[0., t[positive]]
    hits = values >= critical[:, None]
    crossing = np.full(n, grid[-1])
    crossing[hits[:, 0]] = 0.
    first = hits.argmax(axis=1)
    idx = np.flatnonzero(first > 0)
    j = first[idx]
    before, after = values[idx, j - 1], values[idx, j]
    crossing[idx] = grid[j - 1] + (grid[j] - grid[j - 1]) * (critical[idx] - before) / (after - before)
    return time_scale * tau, curve, secant, time_scale * crossing
